notices.title: Snishaper-Droid 1.0.0 发布
notices.body:
本次更新内容：
- fix(gomobile): unexport the notices payload types so gomobile keeps the App-only Java surface by @dongle in `edf277a6df4916bb70766e29c8c5a108ddadf713`
- chore(release): v1.0.0 (release) by @github-actions[bot] in `abfb066fab46f71a5c20ef0d6097fdab36c956d0`
- docs(spec): mark verification tasks complete and fix the gen-defaults assets path by @dongle in `f3b5650dfb9252c380cda87739a4eb1351b68e1b`
- fix(build): regenerate the 226-group default rules and align the test assertions by @dongle in `36905131baa5d53d12702839d3bbe7fe5be265d9`
- docs(spec): mark T022 complete by @dongle in `c0d5c4c9d59fa5a81b722b9ceab39d9d598addf8`
- docs(spec): add the droid-notices-migration spec by @dongle in `2cb44e147b1632b3e310e156ff5796c2e117dbcd`
- feat(android): port the desktop notices feature and add the SnishaperDroid announcement channel by @dongle in `d537f02672b8d38ab49dee8cd1354038ac72a44e`
- Merge pull request #14 from SnishaperTeam/dependabot/gradle/gradle-deps-7d60e7b6db by @dongle in `a27a74ec8915cd5ccd60cd260c03875cf359b0df`
- build(deps): bump gradle-wrapper by @dependabot[bot] in `593af73b81a2fef8ff5f0055c61b591cfab8310b`
- build(deps-dev): bump vite (#16) by @dependabot[bot] in `41ee09bd7ebaebd1ac6e724dcff11da8862079f0`
- build(deps-dev): bump vite (#15) by @dependabot[bot] in `be17d5c652d4a4f32e7c1ab3895087843596051d`
- feat(android): port the desktop config-version and dependabot policy changes by @dongle in `9f180b6dc5c36cbf7ba65d2b6f565fa0e0055683`
- build(deps-dev): bump vite (#13) by @dependabot[bot] in `f39e9e7116e18994d287b4e3e968a8bc6cbac5c2`
- build(deps): bump com.an...

完整更新日志与下载资产见本次发版页面：https://github.com/SnishaperTeam/Snishaper-Droid/releases/tag/v1.0.0
